figures.caption: Pairing-graph concentration and exact full-sequence Levenshtein proximity of test gamma queries to pretraining. Exact-chain exclusion does not remove near neighbors. The distant-edge counts are 5, 5 and 3 across the primary splits.

Primary free-generation results at 64 draws. Small points are the three split means after averaging two model seeds. Diamonds and bars are their mean and descriptive standard deviation, not independent-subject confidence intervals. Likelihood, ranker and fusion order the same conditional candidates.

Fixed-pool retrieval, averaged over two seeds within each of three primary splits and then equally over splits. Pools include all recorded positives by construction and up to 100 unrecorded distractors, or the full role-specific target universe. Deterministic baselines have one value per split. Frequency scores are all zero under primary chain exclusion; that row reflects lexicographic tie breaking, not informative frequency prediction.

Nested complete-component data-efficiency comparison on split 17. Lines are two-seed means; shading spans the two fitted-model estimates and is not a confidence interval. Actual subsets contain 725/1,814/2,249/7,254 edges (10.0/25.0/31.0/100%). The nominal 50% set is undersized. All smaller sets contain only singleton components; the largest component enters at full data, changing composition as well as sample size.

Distinct exposure protocols at 64 draws, shown as two-seed means with individual fitted-model points. The component-disjoint reference is split 17. Directional and source protocols use different query populations and training sets; changes across columns are diagnostic, not causal effects or independent replication. Unseen gamma-to-delta checkpoint selection has only one input and no ranking distractors. Study holdout is not donor-independent validation.

Split-17 sampling-budget and rejection sensitivity. Left: two-seed mean likelihood Hit@5 from nested 16/64/256-draw prefixes with training targets allowed or excluded. Right: calibration-quantile acceptance curves for each seed (solid/dashed); markers are independently calibrated thresholds. All test queries remain in the Hit@5 denominator. No point selects a threshold using test results.

Pretraining mixtures and downstream split-17 NLL. Left: two-seed reconstruction accuracy at corruption-selected sites, including the unchanged fraction of the 80/10/10 rule and deleted sites; aligned-copy accuracy is dotted and vertical ranges span fitted seeds. Other panels retain each downstream fitted-model estimate. All mixtures use 20,480,000 sequence draws; equal draws do not imply equal chain-specific or token exposure.

Ranker negative-training sensitivity on split 17. Ratios 1/3/5 use random-only or mixed random/length-motif negatives. Bars average two model seeds; points retain each fitted ranker. Every setting reuses the primary generator's exact saved candidates and fixed pools, so differences reflect ranking and calibration rather than a new sampling budget.
